text.english: For when you see the udders of the flocks dwindling, what will you do, dear child, when it concerns your kids, whom once, having slipped away from a monstrous wild beast, you implored, that you might stand beside them, steadfast—while they in the pen delicate as they are, shall bleat piteously all around you? text.english: But then let the youths don freshly washed linen garments, three in number, each bearing a sharp, double‑edged sword, snatching up a mottled serpent, the one that most whirls near the fire, yearning for the savour of the grease‑smoke; and him cut joint by joint into nine portions: three for the calling upon of all‑seeing Helios, and three others for Gaia, rich‑soiled, folk‑sustaining, and three for the much‑wise, unerring oracle; and let a cauldron wrought of clay receive them, the blood‑stained portions; and the gift, the oil of Atrytonē, and to pour down the wine of Bromios, summoner of the chorus, and into them let the attendants of the meal cast white salt; and among them too the pungent foreign berry I bid to mix—yellow‑clad, dark‑skinned, most precious; and besides, whatever other things, when mingled together, send to mortals a longing for the meal.
